physical_anchor: Manufactures compound-semiconductor substrate wafers (indium phosphide, gallium arsenide, germanium) via proprietary vertical-gradient-freeze crystal growth.
value_chain_position: Upstream compound-semiconductor substrate producer (InP/GaAs/Ge wafers) feeding photonic-integrated-circuit, silicon-photonics and laser makers (photonics & lasers layer) as well as LiDAR/industrial-robotics sensor makers — a materials toll-taker one to two steps back from both chains, but revenue is diversified across 5G/datacenter-optics/solar rather than concentrated on quantum or robotics specifically.
